<div class="wrap" markdown="1">

{% raw %}
Claiming links your Discord account to your character on the league's roster. An officer approves it once, and from then on:

- event sign-up lists show your in-game name, not your Discord name;
- when you sign up for an event, officers see you already ticked when they record attendance;
- you can use `/my-profile` to set your own preferences and mark yourself on leave.

## How to claim

1. Run `/claim`. Only you can see the reply.
2. Press **Search** and type part of your in-game name (or leave it blank to list everyone).
3. Pick yourself from the list, then press **Request claim**.

That is it. An officer gets your request and approves or declines it. The bot sends you a direct message with the answer, so keep DMs from server members open if you can.

## If you are not in the list

You can only claim a name that is already on the league's roster. If yours is missing, or spelled differently, ask an officer to add or fix it, then search again.

## If it says someone else has claimed it

Each character can be linked to one Discord account. If yours is linked to somebody else by mistake, ask an officer: they can move the link from the roster.

## Good to know

- You can have up to 3 requests waiting at a time, and you cannot ask twice for the same character.
- If you sign up for an event before claiming, the bot may send you a reminder to claim. It will not keep nagging: at most one reminder a week, and your officers can turn it off.
- If you play more than one character on the roster, you can claim each of them; `/my-profile` then asks which one you want to see.
{% endraw %}
